summary: Candidate-conditioned configured resolution through incumbent resolvo, exact shown-default binding and lossless original consumer requests.
effect_meaning: Completed reversible implementation/verification code effects only; no real install effects, commit or WorkAccepted claim.

mechanism.conditioning: Immutable per-coordinate configured manifests attach B1 active dependency requirements to the selected candidate through existing VibevmResolvoProvider::get_dependencies. Incompatible valid definitions become candidate exclusions; corrupt/source data remains operational Source failure. No new solver or bounded retry loop.
mechanism.consumers: B2 receives all original cloned edges for each instance. Full original Request survives success, Conflict, NeedsSelection and Rediscovery; global original edge indices and C1 candidate identities accompany conflict reasons.
mechanism.defaults: DefaultBinding snapshots full Request, full admitted ConfigurationDefinition and exact CandidateIdentity. Selected unmatched defaults require rediscovery before returning effects.
mechanism.effects: Complete selected graph plus candidate-keyed entire FeatureExpansion and selected capability-provider contributions. Only selected graph candidates can produce NeedsSelection or Rediscovery.
mechanism.admission: Normalized definitions remain admitted caller inputs as at B2; C1 receipt equality is validated. No new authored grammar, reader, schema or generated code.
support_boundary: Configured API accepts fixed explicit incoming Vibe consumers with one instance per package. Native selection, cross-package feature forwarding, multiple instances, non-registry sources, conditional targets, requires_any and obsoletes explicitly refuse; support for those combinations is not claimed.
The configured entry is not integrated into install callers here; universal caller-route parity remains separate C3 work.

added.M05C2-CONDITIONING: <ns0:M05C2-CONDITIONING xmlns:ns0="https://vibevm.org/spec/1" status="spec/done">Activation belongs to the exact candidate that introduced it. The existing resolvo solver must carry induced requirements on that candidate's literal. Rejecting a candidate discards its features, providers, dependency effects, subskills and config values. Only selected candidates contribute returned effects; inspecting an unreachable candidate with a mandatory unresolved group never requests selection.</ns0:M05C2-CONDITIONING>
added.M05C2-CONSUMERS: <ns0:M05C2-CONSUMERS xmlns:ns0="https://vibevm.org/spec/1" status="spec/done">Every original incoming consumer edge, selection intent, version constraint and provenance survives candidate rejection unchanged. Evaluate all consumers of one configuration together through the B2 evaluator. A valid older candidate may satisfy the same authorized intent. Conflict evidence retains original consumer reasons alongside the candidate coordinate and exact C1 identity; source errors remain operational errors, never candidate exclusions.</ns0:M05C2-CONSUMERS>
added.M05C2-DEFAULTS: <ns0:M05C2-DEFAULTS xmlns:ns0="https://vibevm.org/spec/1" status="spec/done">Permission to use a declared default binds the exact shown candidate source/content/definition identity. Choosing another definition does not authorize its defaults, even if it is older or the member spelling happens to match. A selected candidate without that exact binding requires rediscovery before effects are returned. Explicit selections retain their original meaning and are not replaced by defaults.</ns0:M05C2-DEFAULTS>
added.M05C2-BOUNDARY: <ns0:M05C2-BOUNDARY xmlns:ns0="https://vibevm.org/spec/1" status="spec/done">The configured resolver consumes admitted, source-bound B1/B2 definitions and immutable C1 metadata. Unsupported combinations refuse before returning mutation effects. Completeness is the existing solver's finite candidate search, never a fixed retry limit. Legacy DepSolver routes, ordinary manifest parsing, B3 opt-in profiles and C1 operational-error propagation remain intact; universal caller-route parity is separate C3 work. Counterexamples compare the entire selected graph and all derived effects, including provider contributions.</ns0:M05C2-BOUNDARY>
added.M05C2-ADMITTED-SURFACE: <ns0:M05C2-ADMITTED-SURFACE xmlns:ns0="https://vibevm.org/spec/1" status="spec/done">The configured Rust entry accepts fixed explicit incoming Vibe consumer requests, one configuration instance per package, and normalized definitions supplied by the admitting caller with exact C1 receipts. It preserves the full request rather than inferring edges from installed state. Default authorization retains that request and the full shown normalized definition as well as its source/content/definition receipt. Native candidate selection, multiple instances of one package, cross-package feature forwarding and non-registry dependency sources refuse. Conditional targets, requires_any and obsoletes also refuse on this entry because the incumbent graph projection does not retain their complete activation support. These refusals are explicit unsupported outcomes, not unsatisfiability claims or a substitute resolver. The ordinary resolver routes and B1/B2 standalone APIs retain their existing semantics.</ns0:M05C2-ADMITTED-SURFACE>
